overall, the fact that the redcoats were meant to be a full takeover wasn't a bad idea, and it would have been picked up super well if it went through as we would have liked and heki got to lead players through an internal jailbreak(perhaps with minuteman aid, Idk what was planned.) but we seemed to have them pacified in fight or flight within an hour, when normal events last around 4 hours that's going to scare them because if the fight is that rough for an hour what happens the other 3? it would have been palatable at a pace that to the players felt like a struggle and not just beating heads on a wall(yes I know mazie mentioned everything had 10 hit points or less but around the tale end that sets a tone that they were barely going to make it. we didn't have to tell them more so much as have a subtle touch to give them a reason to fight(such as defending the locations) and working with them to find temporary out's at least against the first wave.(perhaps organizing our encounters in structured waves instead of laize fairre also could have helped, again on the mods since you told us to plan this.)
